messages:
elaine: Quick sync we've had recurring feedback that the prompt-set approval modal feels modal-heavy for small runs. proposing a lightweight inline approval flyout that shows the prompt, expected assertions, and a single-line rationale. This would avoid full-panel context switches. thoughts? harpreet: Nice idea. Two UX constraints: 1) keep it non-dismissible by accident (confirm/cancel) 2) make keyboard flow smooth (open, review, approve, close). mara: For accessibility, inline flyout must still be a dialog role or use aria-expanded + focus management. a11y-bot, recommended pattern? a11y-bot: Use a focus-trapped dialog if the flyout contains actionable controls. If it's read-only with a single confirm, aria-expanded + aria-controls with focus return on close is acceptable. Example markup suggestion: . When opened, move focus to first focusable element and return focus to the trigger on close. Also ensure escape closes it. jon: Copy concerns: the flyout header should show a concise reason: 'Prompt X 3 tests passed4' or '1 failing assertion' and primary CTA 'Approve' vs secondary 'Open full details'. Keep labels short. elaine: Good. Also want to show a tiny diff-preview snippet (single-line) with ellipsis. No full model output inline for privacy. harpreet: Keyboard: when focus is on a diff row and user presses 'r' open flyout. Space/Enter should behave as open too. Show small hint on focus: 'Press R to review'. Only visible on focus. mara: For screen reader, expose the assertion summary as part of the flyout accessible title. e.g.,

Prompt 7 1 failing assertion

and set aria-labelledby on the container. a11y-bot: Also include aria-live polite when an approval action completes: 'Approval saved for Prompt 7'. That helps SR users get feedback without needing to open the full run logs. jon: Edge case: bulk actions. If someone selects multiple diffs and hits 'Approve selected', open a compact summary flyout that lists counts and shows small sample rows. CTA 'Approve selected (N)'. If any item has failing assertions above threshold, disable primary CTA and show 'Review required' inline. elaine: Implementation note: support an experimental flag 'inline-approve' and telemetry events: inline_approve_opened, inline_approve_confirmed, inline_approve_blocked, inline_approve_open_source (keyboard/filter/button). cc @product-analytics harpreet: Visual: neutral card with 2 action buttons. Primary color for approve but subdued. Ensure 4.5:1 contrast on text and buttons. Use subtle elevation and close affordance in top-right. mara: Microcopy alternative for blocked CTA: 'Review required 1 failing assertion'. Keep it short and actionable. a11y-bot: Also check screen reader order: header -> assertion summary -> approve button -> open details link. Use logical DOM order matching visual. jon: One last UX nit: make the 'Open full details' link open the panel on a new tab or side panel state? Prefer side panel to preserve flyout close state. We'll prototype both. elaine: Action items: 1) harpreet to mock inline flyout and keyboard hints 2) jon to draft microcopy variants 3) mara to write aria snippets and test checklist 4) me to coordinate analytics after mock. Plan to ship behind flag for small runs first. harpreet: Mock uploaded: https://redwood.design/links/inline-approve-flyout. Posting comments in 20m. mara: I'll add required a11y tests to the eval-run checklist and share in thread. elaine: Thanks all. If no blocker, we'll aim to roll to 5% of runs as experiment. :rocket:
